rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Very steep street with homes 8-9 m from the kerb and no stopping signs.

drivers.seclusion: Houses line this side, most 8-19 m from the kerb; bush only at the far top end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, but grade is above 12% along its whole length.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, dead-ends in bush.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked on the street; two No Stopping Any Time signs near the top.

sun_shade: Mixed tree shade; open sky along the street, bush shade at the top.
